title: Body initialization
statement: Let $B$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine with at least one work tape, let $q_v,q_i$ be states of $B$, let $stop$ be a Boolean flag, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. Suppose that, from its initial configuration on $x$, with all work tapes blank, $B$ halts at time $T$ and outputs $w$ consecutive true bits. Then for some $t\le 3T+|x|+3w+10$, the body machine with parameters $B,q_v,q_i,stop$, started in its own initial configuration on $x$, is at the anchor on the seam carrying $w$ false bits on tape zero and blank contents on all other tapes.
